CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the registration of a crime in Crime No.20/2024 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 read with Section 34 of the IPC, under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry NC: 2024:KHC:44685 Prohibition Act, 1961 and under Sections 4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri. S.N. Sameer and Sri. M.K. Niyazuddin, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners,
Sri. Rangaswamy R., learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. Nizam Abbas, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3.
During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement and have placed on record such settlement along with the joint affidavit.

Terms of settlement reads as follows:
"JOINT AFFIDAVIT We, 1) Mrs Fathima, W/o M. H. Fazlulla @ Fazalulla, Aged about 70 years, R/o No.4/143-1, Bypass road, Infront of Police Ground, Kushalnagar,
Kodagu-571234,

2 2) Mr M H Fazlulla @ Fazalulla S/o Abdul Hameed, Aged about 83 years, R/o No.4/143-1, Bypass Road, Infront of Police Ground, Kushalnagar, Kodagu 571234, 3)
Farhana Sultana W/o Farhan F, aged about 25 years, R/o No.77, Nishad Mansion,
Royal Enclave, 1st cross, Naidu Nagara, Mysuru-570 007 do hereby solemnly make oath and affirm on state as follows;
1) We state that, the petitioners have preferred this petition to quash the First Information Report registered against petitioners-accused no.2 and 3 in Mysuru City Women Police Station in Crime No.20/2024 for the alleged offence punishable under Section 498 (A), 323, NC: 2024:KHC:44685 504 R/w 34 and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961 and Section 4 of The Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 on the file of Hon'ble 7th Addl Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) & JMFC Court, JLB Road, Mysuru.
2) We state that, at the instance of elders and well- wishers the petitioners and respondent No.2 have amicably settled all their claims, differences,
litigations and disputes against each other.
3) We submit that, the petitioner no.1 is the mother in law and petitioner no.2 is father in law of respondent No.2 and due to extreme differences between the petitioner's son who is the accused no.1 and respondent no.2 it was resolved that the continuation of marriage would not be beneficial to both the accused no.1 and respondent no.2, but detrimental to each other's Interest and hence,
the marriage between the accused no.1 and respondent no.2 is ended by entering into "KHULA NAMA and settlement deed".

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the same, the marriage of petitioner's son who is the accused no.1 and respondent No.2 is dissolved.

4) We submit that, In view of mutual settlement between the petitioners and respondent No.2, the respondent No.2 voluntarily and of her own free will, without any force and coercion, has no objection to quash the F.I.R registered against the petitioners in Mysuru City Women Police Station in Crime No.20/2024 for the alleged offence punishable under Section 498 (A), 323, 504 R/w 34 and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961 and Section 4 of The Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 on the file of Hon'ble 7th Addl Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) & JMFC Court,
JLB Road, Mysuru.
WHEREFORE, we the petitioners No.1 and 2 and the respondent No.2 most respectfully pray that this Hon'ble High Court may kindly be pleased to quash the FIR registered against the petitioners in Mysuru City Women Police Station in Crime No.20/2024 for the alleged offence punishable under Section 498 (A), 323, 504 R/w 34 and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961 and Section 4 of The Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 on the file of Hon'ble 7th Addl Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) & JMFC Court, JLB Road, Mysuru, in the interest of Justice and equity.
